typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{PHONE NUMBER} as string,
		{CONTROLLING PREFERNCE OPTION} as string,
		{CELL PHONE INDICATOR} as string,
		{RECORD STATUS} as string,
		{REFERENCE NUMBER} as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ScruboutFile
ScruboutFile split(PHONE NUMBER == 'TR', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(FooterRow,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput sink(input(
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_CELL_PHONE_INDICATOR as string,
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_RECORD_STATUS as string,
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_REFERENCE_NUMBER as long,
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_CONTROLLING_PREFERENCE_OPTION as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_PHONE_NUMBER = {PHONE NUMBER},
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_CELL_PHONE_INDICATOR = {CELL PHONE INDICATOR},
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_RECORD_STATUS = {RECORD STATUS},
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_REFERENCE_NUMBER = {REFERENCE NUMBER},
		CPSUI_SCRUBOUT_STAGING_CONTROLLING_PREFERENCE_OPTION = {CONTROLLING PREFERNCE OPTION})) ~> PDSCPSUISCRUBOUTSTAGING
